content: Meera Chauhan called insurance agent Anita Sharma to confirm her policy coverage dates (Oct 1, 2026 to Oct 1, 2027) and deductible ($500). She inquired about lowering her $1,150 premium, and Anita applied a $50 safe driver discount, reducing it to $1,100. Meera also requested a digital copy of her insurance card for a rental car, which Anita agreed to email immediately.

action_items: Email a digital copy of the insurance card to the customer
